title: Doubles
examples: Teacher, what does double three mean?
Can you show me double seven?
Is double five the same as five plus five?

explain.say: Today we are learning about doubles. Doubles means you count a number two times. Say double two. Double two means two and two. Two plus two equals four.
Next we look at double five. Double five means five and five. Five plus five equals ten. You can count it out for me.
Let us try another double. Double three means three and three. Three plus three equals six. You are doing so well with these numbers.
We can also look at double four. Double four means four and four. Four plus four equals eight. See how easy that is to count?
In real life, doubles help us count things in pairs. If you have two pairs of socks, you have double two socks. That means four socks.
A common mistake is to only count one number. If you see double five, do not just say five. Remember you must count it two times.

faq.a: It means you are counting a number two times. You are finding the total of two equal groups.
asks: What is double of a number?

faq.q: Is double five the same as five plus five?
faq.a: Yes, it is exactly the same. Double five means five plus five, which equals ten.
asks: How do I write double five?

faq.q: Can I use doubles for bigger numbers?
faq.a: Yes, you can use it for any number. For example, double ten is ten plus ten, which is twenty.
asks: Does this work for big numbers?

faq.a: Yes, double two always means two plus two, which is four. It is a fixed fact.
asks: What is the answer for double two?

faq.q: Do I have to draw pictures for doubles?
faq.a: It helps to draw pictures to see the two groups. You can draw two groups of the same number of objects.
asks: How can I see two groups?

facts: Doubles means adding a number to itself.
If you have two groups, the groups must be the same size.

quiz.why: You count two fingers and then count two more fingers. Four is the correct total.

wrong.0: This is the answer for double four, not double two.
wrong.2: This is only counting the number once, not two times.
wrong.3: This is the answer for double three, not double two.

quiz.why: You have five items and another group of five items. Counting them all gives you ten.

wrong.0: This only counts one group of five, not two groups.
wrong.1: This is the answer for double five plus five, which is too many.
wrong.2: This is the answer for double ten plus five, which is not the question.

quiz.say: If you have two groups of four, what is the total?
quiz.why: You count four items, and then you count four more items. The total is eight.

wrong.1: This is what you get if you multiply four by four.
wrong.2: This only counts one group of four, not two groups.
wrong.3: This is the answer for double six, not double four.
